---
title: "TCGA KIRC data loading and cohort audit"
format: html
---

This short notebook verifies the three inputs used by
[the main analysis](project.Rmd). Patient identifiers are the first 12
characters of a TCGA barcode. Expression samples are restricted to primary
solid tumors (sample type `01`), with one aliquot retained per patient.

```{r}
files <- c(
  clinical = "data/data_clinical_patient.txt.gz",
  mutation = "data/data_mutations.txt.gz",
  expression = "data/RNAseq_KIRC.csv.gz"
)
missing <- files[!file.exists(files)]
if (length(missing)) stop("Missing data files: ", paste(missing, collapse = ", "))

clinical <- read.delim(files["clinical"], skip = 4, check.names = FALSE)
mutation <- read.delim(files["mutation"], check.names = FALSE)
expression <- read.csv(files["expression"], check.names = FALSE)

clinical_ids <- clinical$PATIENT_ID[
  !is.na(clinical$OS_MONTHS) & grepl("^[01]:", clinical$OS_STATUS)
]
mutation_ids <- substr(mutation$Tumor_Sample_Barcode, 1, 12)
barcodes <- names(expression)[-1]
primary_barcodes <- barcodes[substr(barcodes, 14, 15) == "01"]
expression_ids <- unique(substr(primary_barcodes, 1, 12))

common_ids <- Reduce(intersect, list(clinical_ids, mutation_ids, expression_ids))
data.frame(
  dataset = c("Clinical with overall survival", "Mutation", "Primary tumor RNA-seq", "Intersection"),
  patients = c(length(unique(clinical_ids)), length(unique(mutation_ids)),
               length(expression_ids), length(common_ids))
)
stopifnot(length(common_ids) == 354)
```

The raw input provenance and limitations are documented in the README.
